people.name: Jokneam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city in Zebulun

people.name: Mareal
people.line: A place on the border of Zebulun

translations.web: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
translations.bsb: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
translations.kjv: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
translations.asv: and their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth; and it reached to the brook that is before Jokneam;
